scope: Public-data computational research and falsification only. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, or clinical treatment claim.
purpose: Prevent JANUS from contacting researchers merely because a Mirror-Reverse result is interesting or useful. Promotion to outreach requires a genuinely breakthrough-level result with independent evidence and a clean novelty boundary.

breakthrough_gate.G1_PREFROZEN_NOVEL_PREDICTION: A specific prediction, inference rule, or mechanistic law must be frozen before the confirming observation is exposed to the analyzer.
breakthrough_gate.G2_INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION: The prediction must be confirmed by withheld, newly published, or otherwise independent external evidence not used to formulate it.
breakthrough_gate.G3_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_PASS: Explicit reversible or null controls must remain unflagged at the preregistered threshold.
breakthrough_gate.G4_PRIOR_ART_NULL: A broad prior-art search must fail to find an equivalent result, method, or already-known mechanistic interpretation.
breakthrough_gate.G5_CROSS_SYSTEM_OR_STRONG_GENERAL_LAW: The result must replicate across at least two independent viral systems, or establish a comparably strong and independently confirmed general mechanistic law.
breakthrough_gate.G6_MATERIAL_SCIENTIFIC_CONSEQUENCE: The result must materially change model selection, resolve an open mechanistic ambiguity, reveal a previously unrecognized state/transition/context variable, or make a successful new observable prediction.
breakthrough_gate.G7_PROVENANCE_AND_REPLAY: Inputs, freeze point, inference, unblinding, controls, and scoring must be independently replayable without post-hoc retargeting.

outbound_firewall.unlock_condition: terminal == SCIENTIFIC_BREAKTHROUGH and all breakthrough_gate fields have independent PASS receipts

max_chain_2026_08_30.session_blind_BMV: PASS_FOR_METHOD_RELEVANCE_ONLY; three pre-frozen missing-variable classes matched established BMV literature, but latent pretraining knowledge and prior publication prevent novelty credit.
max_chain_2026_08_30.TrV_holdout: VOID_HOLDOUT_CONTAMINATED; search results exposed uncoating information before freeze.
max_chain_2026_08_30.portal_or_contact_duality: FALSIFIED_AS_GENERAL_LAW; picornavirus work supplies a third route in which membrane/receptor context induces a unique local symmetry break in a previously symmetric particle.
max_chain_2026_08_30.source_of_asymmetry_to_forward_reverse_c: SCIENTIFICALLY_PLAUSIBLE_DIAGNOSTIC_BUT_NOT_BREAKTHROUGH; packaging/ejection through the same portal in dsDNA phage/herpes and induced entry-specific asymmetry in picornaviruses are established prior art.
max_chain_2026_08_30.reverse_data_implies_hidden_state_or_mem: PRIOR_ART_OVERLAP; coarse-grained Markov processes, hidden Markov models, hidden entropy production, lumpability and time-reversal/coarse-graining theory already establish the generic mathematical core.

prior_art_kills: viral capsid assembly/disassembly hysteresis and metastability
Markov-state models and transition-path theory for viral capsids
generic inference of hidden irreversibility under coarse-graining
coarse-grained Markov chains as hidden Markov processes and associated memory/lumpability theory
cargo-shell coupling and ordered viral genome release
preformed portal versus host-triggered creation of a unique genome-release site
shared genome packaging/ejection portals in dsDNA phages and herpesviruses

remaining_frontier.name: ORIGINAL_RAW_TRAJECTORY_INFORMATION_GAIN
remaining_frontier.question: Can JANUS extract a pre-specified, previously unreported and materially useful observable from an open raw viral trajectory dataset, survive negative controls and independent replication, and pass a dedicated novelty search?
required_evidence: raw trajectory or single-particle data not reduced to authors' reported summary statistics
analysis question and scoring frozen before outcome inspection

current_verdict.reason: The full current chain produced useful falsifications and representation refinements, but every general mechanism/theorem candidate examined is either contradicted by a valid third-class witness or overlaps established prior art. No newly extracted independent scientific fact has yet survived all seven gates.
